body:
I just tried skullcap (scutellaria galericulata) for the first time about ten minutes ago, and am currently typing under its influence. I'm an experienced cannabis smoker undergoing a temporary weed drought, and thought I'd try some of this to tide me over.
For my first experiment, I put a smallish amount (estimated .2g) in a small joint mixed with tobacco. Smoke was a little woody, but not unpleasant. The effects came on almost immediately.
It isn't really the kind of buzz I get from cannabis - none of the slightly trippy effects that I get from good bud - but a very noticeable relaxed, mellowed out, slightly sleepy feeling. I would imagine that one could get fairly baked at higher doses. On first impressions, I wouldn't say this stuff was a cannabis replacement
.
